Silicon Valley is in California..why: Silicon Valley is the best-known region of California's San Francisco Bay Area, and is placed in California wherever it is described; it follows from nothing else a model holds (its counties and cities are themselves placed through it as often as the reverse).

sources.quote: The San Francisco Bay Area's Silicon Valley is the center of the global technology industry.
It is located in Santa Clara County and southern San Mateo County within the Santa Clara Valley and the San Francisco Bay Area.
Santa Clara County (commonly referred to as the South Bay) is a northern county in the U.S. state of California.

The Walt Disney Company is headquartered.why: Nobody ties a film company to the state of a technology region: people say where Disney has its headquarters (Burbank, California) and where Silicon Valley is, separately. A model takes the state of the valley first and then asks whether Disney's head office is there, so the direct form is all but absent while each premise is common.
